objects.taxonomy_description: Time-telling device designed for wall mounting with a circular face 20-40 cm in diameter. Face features hour numerals (Arabic, Roman, or markers) arranged in a 12-hour circle. Two or three hands (hour, minute, second) rotate from the center. Frame is wood, metal, or plastic in various finishes (oak, black, white, brass). Mounting bracket or keyhole slot on the back. Quartz movement powered by a single AA battery. Glass or plastic crystal covers the face. Some models have a pendulum visible below the face. Overall depth is 5-10 cm.

objects.taxonomy_description: A croissant is a buttery, flaky, crescent-shaped yeast-leavened pastry distinguished by its laminated dough structure and golden-brown crust.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinct crescent or horn-like curvature with tapered ends.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The exterior displays visible, separate flaky layers resulting from the lamination process.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The surface has a golden-brown hue indicative of baking, often with slight variations in browning across the ridges.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The item appears as a baked good with a dry, crisp exterior rather than a soft, smooth, or liquid consistency.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stringed instrument with solid or semi-hollow body (no sound hole required). Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway, contoured edges), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body). Body is wood (alder, mahogany, maple) with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain. Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard (rosewood or maple, 21-24 frets). Pickups (magnetic, 1-3) mounted on body. Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch. Bridge is fixed or tremolo. Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Solid or semi-hollow body with no sound hole required.
Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body).
Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard with numerous frets.
Functional_Components: Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch.
Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.
Material_and_Context: Body is wood with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain.
